description: This PHP source file defines the ThemeModel class within the OrangeHRM corporate branding API module. The class implements the Normalizable interface and uses traits for serialization, representing a data model for theme configurations including properties such as colors, images, and banners. It encapsulates logic to convert the model to an array, including conditional inclusion of filenames for various assets.

classes.name: ThemeModel
classes.description: The ThemeModel class represents the theme configuration data transfer object, serializable into an array format, encapsulating properties such as color variables and image filenames, based on the PartialTheme entity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the model with a PartialTheme entity and setting serialization filters and attribute names.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the ThemeModel instance into an array, incorporating theme properties and optionally including filenames for client logo, banner, and login banner if available.
